statements.impact_statement: The image applies CPython's 3.13-and-below security backport to this exact Wolfi package. ci/test_runtime_media.py constructs the hard-link-to-symlink archive and verifies extraction produces a regular in-tree file before this VEX is used. Source: https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/b8f23e307097552eaea2604383a12ab280520d0d . See docs/ci.md for build provenance.

FFmpeg 9.0.2 contains the upstream fix, and this exact allowlisted build does not compile or expose the affected MPEG program-stream muxer. ci/test_runtime_media.py checks the built binary's muxer inventory before this VEX is used. Source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/9d786e4b5e9b8482651928574de33772aeee7be1 .

FFmpeg 9.0.2 contains the upstream fix, and this exact allowlisted build does not compile or expose the affected DASH demuxer. ci/test_runtime_media.py checks the built binary's demuxer inventory before this VEX is used. Source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/65b0dab903e5975e036b30ecc58f5935d4f151e0 .
